heading: Friday, July 11, 2025
topLine: Moonshot AI releases open-weight Kimi K2.

items.headline: Moonshot AI releases open-weight Kimi K2
items.summary: Kimi K2 is a mixture-of-experts model with 1 trillion total and 32 billion active parameters, released as open weights in Base and Instruct versions and trained on 15.5T tokens with the MuonClip optimizer. Moonshot reports 65.8 on SWE-bench Verified for the non-thinking Instruct model and positions it for agentic and coding use.
